title: OrderHub — Saga & Messaging
description: Kafka listener throughput/latency/errors for the choreographed saga (order.created, payment.approved, payment.failed) plus live logs from Loki. Metrics come from Spring for Apache Kafka's built-in per-container Micrometer timer (`spring.kafka.listener`, container property micrometerEnabled=true by default — no extra config needed), NOT the newer Observation API (spring.kafka.listener.observation-enabled is not set anywhere in this repo, so don't expect trace-correlated listener metrics). Listener containers here don't set an explicit `id` on @KafkaListener, so the `name` label is whatever Spring auto-assigns per container — use the $listener variable rather than hardcoding a value.

panels.title: Listener Throughput (msgs/s)
panels.description: sum(rate(spring_kafka_listener_seconds_count[5m])) by (job, name) — records processed per second per listener container (order-service's PaymentEventConsumer for payment.approved/payment.failed, payment-service's OrderCreatedConsumer, notification-service's PaymentEventConsumer).

panels.title: Listener Avg Processing Time (ms)
panels.description: sum/count average time spent inside each @KafkaListener method per listener. No histogram buckets are configured for this timer either, so this is a mean, not a p95.

targets.expr: 1000 * sum by (job, name) (rate(spring_kafka_listener_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", name=~"$listener"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (job, name) (rate(spring_kafka_listener_seconds_count{job=~"$job", name=~"$listener"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Listener Failures (DLT-bound)
panels.description: rate(spring_kafka_listener_seconds_count{result="failure"}[5m]) by (job, name) — a listener exception here is what DefaultErrorHandler retries 3x (FixedBackOff, 1s) before DeadLetterPublishingRecoverer parks the record on <topic>.dlt (see common-kafka's KafkaReliabilityConfig). Sustained non-zero values here mean records are landing on a .dlt topic and need manual inspection/replay.

panels.title: Service Logs
panels.description: Live logs from Loki, filtered to the services in scope for $job. Promtail labels every container's log stream with `service` = the docker-compose service name (see infra/promtail/promtail.yml), which is the same string as the Prometheus `job` label used elsewhere on this dashboard, so $job is reused here directly.

panels.title: Error/Warn Logs Only
panels.description: Same services, filtered to lines containing ERROR or WARN — the fastest way to spot a failed saga step or a DLT publish without scrolling the full stream. Relies on the JSON structured logging format (logstash-logback-encoder) every service uses.
